title: Design Grammar System Evidence Envelope
description: Machine-readable shape annex for spec/EVIDENCE-CONTRACT.md. This file is authoritative for SHAPE only (field names, types, required-ness); spec/EVIDENCE-CONTRACT.md is authoritative for MEANING (what each canonical status asserts, ordering/identity rules, canonicalization rules, DE-01 acceptance). On conflict, schema wins for shape and prose wins for semantics (D-01). $defs.CanonicalStatus.enum is the single mechanical authority for the 8-member status vocabulary -- no other file may hardcode a second copy of this list.

CanonicalStatus.description: The frozen 8-member canonical status vocabulary (D-02). No renaming, no additions, no merging outside a phase that explicitly revises this contract.

EvidenceRow.description: Per-(rule,object) evidence row. Rows are addressed by the (ruleId, objectId) identity pair -- see spec/EVIDENCE-CONTRACT.md section 4.

ruleId.description: The Metagraph Rule_Id this row evaluates.

objectId.description: The identity of the object/entity this row evaluates the rule against.

warnings.description: Row-scoped, human-readable warnings in the What+Where+How-to-fix style.

inputHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest (uppercase) of this row's canonicalized input, where the envelope-level hash is insufficiently granular.

outputHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest (uppercase) of this row's canonicalized output.

detail.description: Free-text elaboration, e.g. which binding failed or which builtin was unsupported.

EvidenceEnvelope.description: The evidence envelope a stage emits to report the outcome of evaluating one or more rules against a design. Emitted at every stage boundary that produces or transforms a verdict (D-06), not only at final persistence.

contractVersion.description: The EVIDENCE_CONTRACT_VERSION this envelope was produced against.

canonicalizationVersion.description: The CANONICALIZATION_VERSION used to compute any hashes in this envelope.

project.description: The project scope this evidence belongs to.

definitionId.description: The Computgraph/design definition this evidence was produced for.

serviceName.description: The producing service, e.g. dg-grasshopper-evaluator, data-service, dg-reasoner.

emittedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp (Z suffix) of when this envelope was produced.

stage.description: The pipeline stage boundary this envelope was emitted at.

canonicalStatus.description: The envelope-level roll-up status across rows.

rows.description: The per-(rule,object) result rows, ordered lexicographically ascending by objectId, ties broken by ruleId (spec/EVIDENCE-CONTRACT.md section 4).

dgId.description: The dg:-prefixed identity (spec/DG-ID.md) of the subject entity, where resolvable.

sourceRepresentation.description: The native-platform representation this evidence traces back to (Grasshopper/Revit/IFC/Speckle), where applicable.

inputHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest (uppercase) of this stage's canonicalized input.

outputHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest (uppercase) of this stage's canonicalized output.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the graph schema in effect.

ontologyVersion.description: owl:versionInfo of the OWL ontology in effect.

ruleVersion.description: Version/identity marker of the rule corpus evaluated.

shapeVersion.description: Version of the SHACL shapes (ontology/dg-shapes.ttl) in effect, where applicable.

provider.description: LLM provider, where an LLM was involved in producing this stage's evidence.

warnings.description: Envelope-scoped, human-readable warnings in the What+Where+How-to-fix style.
